guitar.notes: Sample titles ("Bone Walker-Stormy Monday") clearly indicate this is T-Bone Walker, pioneering electric blues guitarist known for Gibson hollow-bodies.

tone.target: warm smoky blues clean with edge-of-breakup bite
tone.profile: warm smoky blues clean with edge-of-breakup bite
tone.summary: A classic blues setup using a low-gain preamp (US Deluxe) paired with an American cabinet (US 2x12) to achieve a warm, articulate, and slightly broken-up sound, finished with subtle room ambience.

rig.name: T - Bone Walker-Call It Stormy Monday - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Gentle boost to enhance the initial bite and warmth without adding aggressive crunch.
blocks.gap: The 'Boost' module is used for subtle tone shaping rather than pure gain, matching the 'light tube breakup' requirement.

alternatives.reason: Compression could also add warmth but might lose the desired dry touch.

blocks.purpose: Bypass or use a very low-gain setting to maintain the clean character.
blocks.gap: No dedicated low-gain tube emulation is available in the compact catalog; relying on the preamp/amp choice for breakup.

blocks.purpose: Emulates a classic Fender/Valco combo sound, providing the required warm, articulate clean tone and natural breakup.
Matches the 'small Fender/Valco combo' and '1x12' clue, providing a bright yet warm American voicing.
Enhance the 'smoky mids' and scoop out excessive high-end brightness while keeping the tone focused.
Bypass to maintain the natural tone and avoid unnecessary filtering.
Bypass to avoid 'heavy modulation' and keep the tone dry.
Bypass to avoid 'delay' and maintain the dry touch.
Add 'subtle room' ambience without sounding wet or distracting.

improvements.summary: Swap IR for a smaller, more vintage-voiced cabinet to better match the ES-335/Valco combo clue and enhance the warm, smoky mids.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage 1x12 or small combo IR (e.g., Fender Princeton)
proposals.reason: US 2x12 is too large; a smaller, vintage-voiced cab better matches the ES-335/Valco clue and enhances warmth.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased vintage character and focused mids.
